findings.title: Projected cancellation rows cannot open their cancellation detail
findings.evidence: All 489 real cancellation rows are policy-status projections; B4-003 proof reports cancelationRecordCount=0. Human click on projected rows still returns 'Registro fuera de tu alcance'.
findings.rootCause: The machine proof exercised a synthetic explicit cancelaciones row, not the real projected-policy row path; row detail lookup is not robustly bound to authoritative policyId.
findings.target: Projected row must open cancellation detail by authoritative policy even when no explicit cancelaciones document exists.

findings.title: Cliente 360 horizontal tab scrollbar/affordance is hidden
findings.evidence: Current CSS explicitly sets scrollbar-width:none and hides WebKit scrollbar on .ficha-tabs; Paula reports the previously available navigation affordance is gone.
findings.target: Restore visible, usable horizontal tab navigation without losing existing tabs.

findings.title: Cancellation 'Tasa de fuga' lacks cohort/time-window semantics
findings.evidence: Current implementation is historical cancelled policy editions divided by all policy editions in active country. Counts by country now reconcile (GT 461 + CO 28 = 489) and currencies are separated, but this is not a defined churn cohort.
findings.target: Rename to a truthful historical cancellation ratio or implement an explicit cohort/window before calling it fuga.

findings.title: Some client master country labels disagree with policy country
findings.evidence: Country filters correctly isolate policies, while some Client cells still display Persona · GT inside Colombia results because the label comes from client master country.
findings.target: Do not infer client country from policy country; resolve against authoritative client source and keep mismatch visible until corrected.

findings.title: Renewability is not canonical across create/import/renewal surfaces
findings.evidence: Policy detail already understands renovable YES/NO/UNKNOWN and legacy Cliente360 edit has a checkbox, but the canonical policy form lacks the control; renewal queries/surfaces ignore it; importer defaults imported policies to renovable=true.
findings.target: Canonical tri-state renewability; no renewal queue/cronogram/campaign for renovable=false; unknown remains fail-closed; imports never force true without source.

findings.title: Certificates, monthly declarations and policy-linked annexes are not modeled as first-class child movements
findings.evidence: Canonical endoso workflow exists for approved modifications, but recurring monthly certificates/declarations are not represented independently from new policies.
findings.target: Keep master policy as policy; store monthly certificates/declarations/annexes as policy-linked child movements/documents with type, period/unique flag, effective date, reference/document, risk detail and optional premium delta. Use canonical endoso workflow for changes that alter policy/risk.

findings.title: Client, insured/titular and optional contact are conflated
findings.evidence: New-client form has one identity/contact. Edit only has contactoAlt as a combined string. Canonical projection already anticipates contactoPrincipalNombre/Telefono/Correo aliases.
findings.target: Persist real commercial client separately from optional contact; effective contact defaults to real client. Policy relationship can separately identify insured/titular/tomador without changing the CRM client.

findings.title: Client creation does not proactively link/create Drive expediente
findings.evidence: Drive backend already creates or links client folder on first confirmed document, and a folder matcher exists, but new-client creation does not call an ensure-folder operation.
findings.target: After canonical client creation, search/match unique existing expediente; link if unique, create if none, fail closed if ambiguous. Drive failure must not roll back client creation; mark expediente pending and retry.

findings.title: Historical cancellation reason is absent for all projected rows
findings.evidence: Current projection reads policy motivoCancelacion/cancellationReason; human view shows 'Sin motivo registrado' at 100%.
findings.target: Future cancellation flow must require cancellation date and reason; historical missing reasons remain explicit data-quality items, editable without fabricating values.

acceptedVisualResults: Country filter now isolates policy/cancellation universes by selected country.
Renewals visual layout and country segmentation are acceptable in Paula review.
Cronograma now exposes renewal events and +N day drill-down acceptably.

financialReconciliationCarry.rule: No operational correction is applied from an ambiguous row without Paula/source confirmation; missing source remains fail-closed.
